Problem Statement:
Create a C program that uses conditional compilation to include or exclude debug information based on a macro definition. You need to handle the scenario where debug information is enabled only when a macro DEBUG is defined. The program should include debug messages if DEBUG is defined and exclude them otherwise. 
Input Description:
An integer from the user. 
Output Description:
Print whether the integer is even or odd. Include debug information if DEBUG is defined. 
Sample Input:
10 
Sample Output:
Debug: Input value is 10
The number is even
